source: data/post/mlb, 223 contests, per-contest clustered t; DK entry history via bench/contest-select.mjs

rules.rule: primary stack of 5 hitters (the DK maximum)
rules.evidence: all tiers t 3.86 (145/223 contests better); no-stack (<=3) -37% ROI t -4.79; 5-3 vs 5-2 shape indifferent (t 0.08)

rules.rule: at least one pitcher in the top 3 by projection; never a pitcher outside the top 3 on both slots
rules.evidence: outside top 3: -34% ROI t -2.96 all tiers, -31.5% t -3.04 at $100+; Mega 8s winners 90% top-3

rules.rule: Stokastic lineup sim ROI in the top half; in MLB prefer the 10-25% band over the top 5%
rules.evidence: top half t 3.90 all tiers; top 5% -6% at $100+ (ns), 10-25% band +24% t 2.23; opposite of NFL showdown where top 5% is best

rules.rule: lineup ownership sum not in the bottom third of the field
rules.evidence: bottom-third ownership -21 pts t -2.63 at $100+, -42 pts t -4.15 at $20-99; unduplicated never significant; Mega 8s winners avg own sum 115, Full Count 121

rules.rule: primary stack team ranked 2-8 by projection is the winners' modal profile; top-1 chalk stack is allowed but not favoured
rules.evidence: Mega 8s winners: stack team proj rank avg 6.1/19, only 5/21 top-3 owned, 11/21 own rank >= 6; Full Count 7/31 stacked the #1 team
winners avg $49,700 (Mega 8s) and $49,750 (Full Count); every Four-Point/Full Count winner >= $48,500

rules.rule: no two identical lineups from this account in one contest
rules.evidence: 12 of 833 Full Count entries were self-duplicates; a duplicate can only split with yourself

rules.rule: no late swap or substitution that fails a hard rule, regardless of how good the hunch is
rules.evidence: 2026-09-21 NYG@LAR: two hunch swaps cost 32 points and a cash; the instrument was right both times

contest_selection.evidence: bench/contest-select.mjs MLB --lobby, complete DK history 36,619 entries
